Hi Lauren,

Thanks again — EdgeGrid's operations team is preparing the isolated facility at Site-7 for our initial Redwood runtime bake. Site-7 is a physically dark facility (no internet egress) and will require couriered media plus an operator-signer on arrival.

We'd like to confirm a target activation window the week of Apr 19. Specific asks:
- Confirm the exact signed bundle filename we'll receive and the signing roster (who will countersign on Redwood's side).
- Any manifest-level HMACs or checksum expectations for the courier to verify on-site.
- Operator instructions for bootstrapping the appliance (approx 30–45 minute window) and fallback contact if the signer quorum isn't present.

Can you also confirm whether the bundle includes a small offline patch (delta) vs full image? Logistics needs file sizes for shipping.

Regards,

Subject: Re: Dark-facility activation window request / manifest handoff

Samir —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on the same page and can support the Apr 19–21 window. High level answers below; technical details and the signed manifest are attached.

1) Signed bundle
- File: redwood_signed_bundle_v1.2.manifest (attached). This manifest includes the SHA256 of the image artifact and the per-layer HMAC. The actual image payload is shipped separately on encrypted SSD.
- Signing roster: Lauren Bishop (Release Owner), Vivek Kulkarni (Head of Private Deploy), and an on-call field-signing delegate (to be named). All three signatures will be present on the manifest before courier handoff.

2) Manifest expectations
- Please verify the SHA256 and the manifest signature before mounting. If the manifest signature fails, do not install — contact our signers.
- Courier should present chain-of-custody paperwork and a tamper-evident seal id (we include these in the manifest metadata).

3) Payload type and shipping sizing
- The payload is a full image + a 120MB delta for late fixes. Total uncompressed size: ~240GB. Encrypted on-disk size: ~180GB.
- We will provide the exact shipping weight and courier ETA to TransCloud no later than Apr 15.

4) Operator bootstrap steps (short)
- Mount the SSD, execute /usr/local/bin/redwood-apply --manifest redwood_signed_bundle_v1.2.manifest
- The tool performs signature verification, integrity checks, and a staging validation (5–10 mins).
- Activation requires 2 out of 3 signer confirmations. If quorum not met, the tool will not progress and will offer an emergency rollback path.

Attached: redwood_signed_bundle_v1.2.manifest (text), operator_rollout_matrix.xlsx (matrix with step owners and escalation numbers).

I'll circulate a quick canary test plan the morning of Apr 19. Vivek, looping you for technical comments on the bootstrap and network isolation checklist.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Quick technical notes from my side:

- Networking: Site-7 is fully isolated with only a maintenance jump-host allowed on an isolated VLAN. Confirmed: no egress to public internet is permitted during activation. Our bootstrap only requires local mounts and signer confirmations entered manually through the operator console.

- Time sync: Please ensure the operator console has accurate NTP from the internal stratum before signature verification — signature timestamps are validated to prevent replay. If NTP is unavailable, we have an offline timestamp verification mode; it requires additional manual attestation (see manifest appendix).

- Quorum and emergency fallback: The standard 3-signer quorum (Lauren, Vivek, on-call delegate) is preferred. For this customer, given physical constraints, we can accept an onsite delegate + 1 remote signer (entered via secure phone OTP) as a degraded but acceptable fallback. That must be pre-approved and recorded in the operator_rollout_matrix.xlsx.

- Secure console: Operators will use the sealed console image; no USB insertion other than the encrypted SSD is allowed. If operators attempt to bypass the flow, the installer will abort and produce an audit bundle for later review.

I'll join the Apr 19 canary window remotely and be on the signatory list in case we need to toggle fallback policies.

—Vivek
VP, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
